visual_logic.surface_detail: Mottled 'Olive' and 'Yellow' skin for camouflage in shallow reefs, mapped uniformly across its full horizontal lateral flank.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. Hero focus remains on the 'mixed' anatomy—the transitional combination of a primitive lizard-like tail and a fish-like fluke, oriented perfectly parallel to the camera plane.
visual_logic.environment: Shallow, turquoise lagoon. The coral-like Triassic structures and rocks are shifted entirely into the distant background layers to preserve a sharp, measurable silhouette line.

pose: The small, primitive ichthyosaur is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original quick, darting motion among rocks is stabilized into a flat, level, straight cruising path, extending its pointed snout, compact torso, paddles, and transitional tail fluke end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
